integrity: The proof is self-contained modulo the standard Witt decomposition for nondegenerate finite quadratic spaces. Finite computations independently corroborate nine small configurations and all linear endomorphisms in three three-dimensional ternary configurations; finite tests are not the proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite fields of odd order; nondegenerate symmetric product forms; rank-one composition-idempotent algebra endomorphisms; dimension at least three. The analogous characteristic-two and higher-rank problems are not covered. Publication priority is not independently certified.
title: Witt-type edge gaps in commuting rank-one evolution-algebra retractions
